_about: Phase 2 of the devil contracts (docs/devil_contract_phase2.md). Data, not code: edit here (or in a resource pack of the mod's assets) to change what a rank asks for. ep = the existence points (Tensura EP) the player needs per rank (the server setting ep.scale multiplies them); chance = the base chance that a finished ritual brings the devil; relicBonus = what holding an item of that devil adds (tag anime_multiverse:devil_relics/<id>); devils = per devil: trial (it fights before it agrees), betray (the chance it turns on everyone in the circle but the caller), ep (its own requirement, 0 or missing = its rank's).
